translations.web: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
translations.bsb: To those selling doves He said, “Get these out of here! How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace!”
translations.kjv: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
translations.asv: and to them that sold the doves he said, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house a house of merchandise.
